## Checklist

- [ ] No network calls, analytics or accounts added
- [ ] Original work only, nothing copied from other apps (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/aswin099/hoverbox/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] No private files, file paths or personal data in code, tests or screenshots
